remarks: Charming 1951 Mid-Century California cottage on a quiet cul-de-sac in desirable San Roque Gardens. Oak floors and classic character welcome you in, and the bright living room has a wall of windows overlooking the expansive back yard. The spacious lot offers mature fruit trees with space for gardens, gatherings, and room to dream, with a detached, finished, two-car garage adding flexibility. It's a neighborhood where evening walks have a way of turning into conversations. Mackenzie Park and the Santa Barbara Golf Club are close, and hiking trails are just minutes away. Breakfast at Farmer Boy, a pastry and coffee run to Renaud's, dinner at Harry's or Tee-Off, and shopping at Gelson's, Bristo
